ambiguities.explanation: The logical connective 'and' lacks defined operator precedence, yielding two mutually exclusive conditions: the message is either (received from Security Manager AND part of the B-file) or (part of the B-file according to the mapping rules), independently of whether it was received from Security Manager.
possible_interpretations: The message must be both received from Security Manager and part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules.
The message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules, regardless of whether it was received from Security Manager.
